name: r1_workplace_award
note: R1 case A (BUGS #89). Dispatch one 2001 job through the stock Work Place UI, then advance only the client's server-time model past start_time+need_time and reopen the stock window. The stock due-cell render calls getRewards(team.award); the LOAD_INFO/SET_PARTNER row carries no award, so TreasureWindow.lua:561 indexes nil. No database state is rewritten: the reply shape is what the client received.
steps: lua:local w=xyd.WindowManager.get():getWindow('treasure_window') if not w then error('vc-r1a-no-window') end local m=w.treasureModel if not m.teams[2] then error('vc-r1a-no-team') end xyd.WindowManager.get():openWindow('treasure_prepare',{locationId=2,types={2001},titleName=xyd.tables.treasureLocation:name(2),typeName=2001})

lua:local w=xyd.WindowManager.get():getWindow('treasure_edit') if not w then error('vc-r1a-edit') end local found=false local function walk(n) if found then return end if n:getName()=='item_bg' then for _,c in ipairs(n:getChildren()) do local ls=c._LuaListeners and c._LuaListeners[cc.NODE_TOUCH_EVENT] if ls then for _,l in ipairs(ls) do l.listener_({name='began'}) l.listener_({name='ended'}) end found=true return end end end for _,c in ipairs(n:getChildren()) do walk(c) end end walk(w:nodeByName('list')) if not found then error('vc-r1a-no-crew-touch') end
lua:local w=xyd.WindowManager.get():getWindow('treasure_prepare') if not w or #w.heroIds~=1 then error('vc-r1a-selection') end

lua:local m=xyd.ModelManager.get():loadModel(xyd.ModelType.TREASURE) _G.vcR1Team=m.teams[2] if not vcR1Team or vcR1Team.start_time==0 or #vcR1Team.partners~=1 then error('vc-r1a-not-dispatched') end local st=xyd.ServerTime.get() if not st.canGetServerTime_ then error('vc-r1a-no-server-time') end st.serverTime_=vcR1Team.start_time+vcR1Team.need_time+30 local wm=xyd.WindowManager.get() local w=wm:getWindow('treasure_window') if not w then error('vc-r1a-window-gone') end wm:closeWindow(w) wm:openWindow('treasure_window') if not wm:getWindow('treasure_window') then error('vc-r1a-reopen-failed') end
